facts.claim: An assessment of twenty-five cents per share was levied on the capital stock of the North Noonday Mining Company at a meeting of the Board of Directors on June 5, 1879.
facts.quote: Notice is hereby given. that at a meeting of the Board of Directors. held on the 5th day of June, 1579, an assessment (No. 2). Of. 25 cents per share was levied upon the capital Stock of the corporation
